apps.name: Soccer Stats
apps.subtitle: Track goals, assists, and match stats
apps.localizedDescription: Track your player’s goals, assists, and match stats across seasons, and score games live from the sideline.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Today's finished games now have a "Finish scoring" button next to Score
  game. Tap it when you're done and the Score game button goes away
- Chart dates are easier to read: they're shorter (8/9 instead of 08-09) and
  slanted so they don't run together

- The Live button is now called "Score game"
- Today's games keep their Score game button all day, even after you've
  finished scoring, so you can go back in and fix things
- Mark a game as "Guest player" when your player plays for another team, and
  optionally say which team. It gets a Guest tag. Your player's goals and
  assists still count, but the result stays out of the team's record,
  standings and head-to-head

- The season page is much more compact, so your games start near the top
  - The team name and record now sit under the season name in the header
  - The Events, Team and Stats tabs are slimmer
  - Start match, Log match, Import from photo and Add to calendar moved into
    a green + button in the bottom corner of the Events tab
- The team card (photo, players, record and Edit) is now at the top of the
  Team tab, and "Edit team name and photo" is in the season's ⋮ menu

- The Events tab's buttons take much less room, so the first game shows
  without scrolling: Start match and Log match sit side by side, with small
  Import and Calendar buttons below. Both are also in the season's ⋮ menu

- Games on the same day are ordered by kickoff time: in Results the latest
  game is on top and the earliest at the bottom; Upcoming lists the earliest
  first. Games with no kickoff time count as the start of their day
- Importing a schedule or results now saves the Match # onto games already in
  the app that don't have one (shown as "Match #: none → 935"), even when
  nothing else changed
- Imports compare every game detail and update whatever differs: score,
  date (rescheduled games), kickoff, home/away, location, opponent name,
  Match #, game vs friendly, and notes (added to yours, never replacing
  them). Your player's stats (goals, assists, shots, minutes, position,
  cards, play-by-play) are never touched
- Results show your player's goals and assists as colored chips (green ⚽,
  blue 👟), so games they contributed to stand out; games with neither show
  just the score
- The Match # shows as a small badge at the start of a game's date line
- 👟 is now the assist icon everywhere (results, milestones, recap image)
